hero.oneLiner: IntraSoft positions itself as a top-300 Amazon US retailer/enabler for brand partners, transitioning from an inventory-heavy model to an asset-light Vendor Direct model to scale profitably.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Amongst the top 300 e-commerce retailers on the Amazon US marketplace, enabling small and medium brand partners to sell on Amazon without needing dedicated in-house resources.
- Premium seller on Amazon US with a 96% life-time rating and a network of 300+ brand partners, servicing millions of marketplace customers.
- Sells 150,000+ products across major categories including home & kitchen, garden & outdoor, and tools.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Inventory Heavy Model previously drove high working capital requirements and continuously rising debt; the shift to Vendor Direct has been used to pay down debt and cut interest costs.
- Technology investment is prioritized to improve transaction efficiency & speed, bandwidth & scalability, automation levels, and security.
